evidence: The ALD film growth experiments were performed in a F-120 ALD reactor (ASM Microchemistry Ltd.), where the two 5 cm /C2 5 cm substrates are located face to face within a distance of 1 mm. A ZnS growth cycle consisted of the following steps: DEZ exposure/N 2 purge/H2S exposure/N2 purge ¼ 1/3/1/2 s, while an In2S3 growth cycle consisted of In(acac)3 exposure/N2 purge/H2Se x p o s u r e / N2 purge ¼ 1/3/1/2s .
